mappingBasis: Saved generated-original completion order; confirmed by named heroes in owner feedback. Profile ranking preserved separately.

feedback.name: Nerys Fleet
feedback.comment: Nerys' bow looks a little weird and I don't know why she's two handing it. The string also disappears over her body.
feedback.action: Rework bow into a clear shortbow; ready pose uses one hand at the central grip, with the other free. Continuous straight undrawn string tip-to-tip, rendered visibly across the body. Preserve the character direction.

feedback.name: Mab Vale
feedback.comment: Love it. Great design. Made me realise how we need more different race characters.
feedback.action: Preserve the liked spindle/thread design. Broaden ethnicity and facial diversity across future additions; do not recolour existing approved characters to satisfy a quota.

feedback.name: Tamsin Rook
feedback.comment: Strong design as well. Good work.
feedback.action: Preserve the liked core design and scar/undercut identity; earlier unwanted quiver and warblade compatibility still need attention.

feedback.name: Peregrine Clocks
feedback.comment: He needs hair that's of African origin. He has white guy hair (facial and head). I like that he's old though.
feedback.action: Preserve elderly identity and skin tone; revise head hair to short tightly coiled silver hair and beard to an appropriately textured close silver beard. Match both views.

feedback.name: Flint Mercer
feedback.comment: Is he intentionally short? He looks stocky and short for some reason. I think it's that his feet are massive compared to his head.
feedback.action: Preserve stocky build, not a deliberately short stature. Reduce oversized boots and restore balanced head/body/foot proportions.

feedback.name: Merrick Low
feedback.comment: Again his bow is a bit dodgy looking (hand hold not in the centre).
feedback.action: Rebuild bow geometry and place the hand at its central grip. Continuous correctly attached straight undrawn string.

feedback.name: Hilda Vane
feedback.comment: Weirdly the bow is much better on this character.
feedback.action: Preserve the liked archer design and stronger bow geometry; this does not approve the whole production pack.

feedback.name: Sable Quill
feedback.comment: Wow Sable Quill looks exceptional! Big fan of this one.
feedback.action: Preserve the strongly liked face, colours and costume. Earlier reviewer suggestions do not override this direct feedback; any ledger/focus change must preserve the identity the owner likes.

feedback.name: Ione Hart
feedback.comment: Ione is great. My only issue is with the top of the staff and the design of the tome.
feedback.action: Retain Ione. Refine the prism staff head into a coherent glass focus and redesign the tome with clear broad fire/cold prism motifs, matching the focus detail.

feedback.name: Adela Wych
feedback.comment: Very cool design. Just need a review of the top of the staff.
feedback.action: Retain Adela. Refine the closed-arch staff head while preserving the liked overall design and violet lantern.

feedback.name: Gideon March
feedback.comment: Decent.
feedback.action: Retain as a viable design candidate; no additional owner correction specified.

feedback.name: Ysabet Fen
feedback.comment: Love Ysabet but her bow is skewed and the string isn't right either.
feedback.action: Retain Ysabet. Rebuild bow with coherent symmetric limb geometry, central grip and a continuous tip-to-tip string; ensure the bow remains in front of the body.

feedback.name: Roscoe Bell
feedback.comment: Roscoe proportions are weird. His body is so big compared to his head.
feedback.action: Keep the heavy build but rebalance head against torso; massive physique should not read as a tiny head on an oversized body.

feedback.name: Petra Crowe
feedback.comment: Cool visual design. Her kit feels a bit standard. How is she different from a basic archer?
feedback.action: Retain the liked visual design. Kit review required: current prepared heavy shot is insufficiently distinct from existing setup/release archers. Do not claim its intended identity already delivers a unique playstyle.

feedback.name: Rufus Wold
feedback.comment: No unarmed characters.
feedback.action: Withdraw Rufus from playable consideration under the direct no-unarmed rule. Preserve the draft as an archive; do not silently rearm him or move him into an NPC roster.

feedback.name: Nim Rowan
feedback.comment: Bow is dodgy and needs work but the design is decent.
feedback.action: Retain visual direction; rebuild bow, central grip and connected string.

feedback.name: Celandine Orr
feedback.comment: Holy mage is good.
feedback.action: Retain the holy-mage direction and anatomical tome/split-circle identity.

feedback.name: Eamon Grey
feedback.comment: Eamon is decent too.
feedback.action: Retain Eamon as a viable candidate; no additional owner correction specified.

feedback.name: Ludo Finch
feedback.comment: Would require new weapon and off hand for one character. Makes him low priority.
feedback.action: Defer Ludo behind equipment/crafting work: a one-character crossbow and bolt-case pair does not justify immediate categories. No new gear implementation.

feedback.name: Maud Flint
feedback.comment: Again, new weapon type so would have to wait for crafting/skilling overhaul.
feedback.action: Defer Maud behind the crafting/skilling overhaul: combat poleaxe category is not currently available. No new gear implementation.
